newsitem.title: KENYA: 17 killed in Kenyan bus crash.
newsitem.headline: 17 killed in Kenyan bus crash.

text.p: Seventeen people were killed when a crowded bus travelling in western Kenya collided with a truck near Nakuru, 160 km (100 miles) northwest of Nairobi, Kenya television reported.
The bus was badly damaged in the Friday night crash.
In another incident, eight men died when the wall of a pit dug by gold miners collapsed at Sabatia, western Kenya, on Saturday.
One gold prospector was trapped in the mine, and the other seven were trying to rescue him when the wall collapsed, burying them, police reported.
